map.黄酮口服→胃肠/肝首过糖基化与葡糖醛酸化，入血多为苷元或结合物；MW 低易透膜者: Flavonoids taken orally undergo gastrointestinal and hepatic first-pass glycosylation and glucuronidation, so what enters the blood is mostly the aglycone or conjugates; those with low MW and good membrane permeability have higher oral bioavailability.
map.静脉注射绕首过，F≈100%，直接入血经肝 CYP 代谢，: Intravenous injection bypasses first-pass metabolism, F is about 100%, enters the blood directly and is metabolized by hepatic CYP,
map.口服经肝/肠壁代谢使 F 下降，剂量需相应提高或改剂型。: Oral dosing loses F through hepatic and intestinal wall metabolism, so the dose must be raised accordingly or the dosage form changed.

map.按化合物类别与给药途径给出 I/II 相代谢途径参考，不做结构级预测: Class-level phase I/II pathway reference by compound type and route of administration; not a structure-based prediction
map.本工具是「类别模板」：按黄酮、生物碱、皂苷等类别的共性代谢规律列出常见 I/II: This tool is a class-level template: it lists common phase I/II reactions and representative products shared by flavonoids, alkaloids, saponins and other classes, and estimates mass shifts from the molecular weight you enter. It does not parse structures, simulate enzyme kinetics or distinguish substituents and species differences; the true metabolites of a compound must be confirmed experimentally (e.g. by LC-MS/MS).
